|update=complete|source=[https://www.rsssf.org/tablest/thai06.html rsssf.com] }} ==Season notes== * In this season, the winner and runner-up of the [[Provincial League]], [[Chonburi FC]] and [[Suphanburi FC]] began the practice of moving to play in the [[Thai Premier League]]. ==Kor Royal Cup== The [[Kor Royal Cup]] was an end of season match between the two clubs that finished first and second in the final Premier League standings. [[Osotsapa FC|Osotsapa]], who came second in the Premier League, beat league Champions [[Bangkok University FC|Bangkok University]] 2–1. ==Queen's Cup== 2nd Level [[Royal Thai Navy FC|Royal Thai Navy]] upset the odds when they won the 32nd edition of the [[Queen's Cup (football)|Queen's Cup]] defeating [[Krung Thai Bank FC|Krung Thai Bank]] 1–0. ==Asian representation== *League champions and runners up [[Thailand Tobacco Monopoly FC|Thailand Tobacco Monopoly]] and PEA should have taken part in the [[2006 Asian Champions League]], but both clubs failed to meet the respective time frame to send in squad lists. Both teams were duly disqualified from the competition. Rumor was rife that neither club wished to take part due to the financial costs. *[[Chonburi FC|Chonburi]] reached the final of the [[Singapore Cup]] in their first ever participation. They were within one minute of lifting the silverware against [[Tampines Rovers FC|Tampines Rovers]] but succumbed in extra time to lose 3–2. [[Provincial Electricity Authority FC|Provincial Electricity Authority]] also took part in the competition but got knocked out in the first round against [[Woodlands Wellington FC|Woodlands Wellington]]. ==Annual awards== ===Coach of the Year=== *{{flagicon|Thailand}} [[Somchai Subpherm]] - [[Bangkok University FC|Bangkok University]] ===Player of the year=== *{{flagicon|Thailand}} [[Punnarat Klinsukon]] - [[Bangkok University FC|Bangkok University]] ===Top scorer=== *{{flagicon|Thailand}} [[Pipat Thonkanya]] - 12 Goals[[Football records in Thailand]][[BEC Tero Sasana FC|BEC Tero Sasana]] ==Champions== The league champion was [[Bangkok United F.C.|Bangkok University]].
